blocks.content: Quiz: How does flex-wrap: wrap help with responsive layouts?
Tap an option below to answer:
It hides items that don't fit.
If it hid items you'd silently lose content. flex-wrap moves items to a new row so nothing disappears.
If it hid items you'd silently lose content. flex-wrap moves items to a new row so nothing disappears.
It lets flex items wrap to the next line when there isn't enough space, so content doesn't overflow.
Items move to a new row when the container is too narrow. Nothing overflows, nothing hides.
Items move to a new row when the container is too narrow. Nothing overflows, nothing hides.
It only works with exactly two columns.
Flexbox doesn't think in columns. Items fill rows based on available space and their flex-basis.
Flexbox doesn't think in columns. Items fill rows based on available space and their flex-basis.
flex-wrap handles reflow within one container. A nav switching direction still needs a media query.
flex-wrap handles reflow within one container. A nav switching direction still needs a media query.
